synthesis.problem: DEV-2591 removed org_id from ListScans ClickHouse queries because filtering by the kit's current Postgres owner silently dropped historical rows. Production now filters kit_id only. scans_cold is sorted (org_id, scanned_at, kit_id, id), so kit_id cannot prune — measured 2.21B rows scanned vs ~24.5M with an org predicate. p50 went from 0.21s to 18s; customers hit ClickHouse error 159 (30s).
synthesis.outcome: Restore org_id pruning using DISTINCT org_id from zod.kit_last_scan for the authorized kit set (historical orgs), keep kit_id IN (...), restore scopeForOrgs, cache+invalidate with Kit::forgetCachedKits, invert ClickhouseScanQueryShapeTest, verify parity on moved kits and EXPLAIN row counts.
